# mws_auditlogs_collector (Data Source)



## Примеры использования

```terraform
data "mws_auditlogs_collector" "example" {
  collector_name = "example-collector"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `collector_name` (String)

### Optional
